title: NeoFrontier
description: A lightweight NeoForge survival and Create-focused modpack with exploration, building, storage, voice chat, and multiplayer-friendly performance improvements.
body:
NeoFrontier is a carefully curated NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack that enhances vanilla Minecraft without losing its original feel. The goal is to provide a polished survival experience with improved performance, quality of life, exploration, and visual immersion while remaining lightweight enough for a wide range of PCs.

Explore new structures, improve farming with Farmer's Delight, organize your storage with Sophisticated Storage and Sophisticated Backpacks, discover the world using Waystones and Explorer's Compass, and enjoy numerous visual and audio enhancements that make Minecraft feel more alive.

The pack includes extensive client and server optimizations to reduce lag, improve FPS, shorten loading times, and increase overall stability. Every mod has been selected to work well together, providing a balanced experience for both singleplayer and multiplayer.

Whether you're building, exploring, adventuring with friends, or simply looking for a smoother vanilla+ experience, NeoFrontier delivers a modern Minecraft experience with improved gameplay, performance, and immersion.
